test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is the first large-scale iron and steel plants in India?
solution: The correct answer is __**TISCO.**__ __** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__** • TISCO is the first large-scale iron and steel plant in India. • Tata Iron and Steel Company or TISCO is the first iron and steel manufacturing plant in India which was founded and established by Jamsetji Tata and Dorabji Tata respectively on 26th August 1907 at Jamshedpur, Jharkhand. • The industry is located on the banks of the Subarnarekha and Kharkai rivers. • These rivers help in the industrial uses and water treatment for the industry.
